The '''<Gnomish Federation>''' is the central administrative entity of the Gnomes, founded shortly after the fall of [[Gnomeregan]] as a formal replacement to the ruling council. Commissioned by [[High Tinker]] [[Geblin Mekkatorque]], it acts as the governing body of Gnomish society.  

Its bureaucratic structure is comprised of the governorship, the administrative level and four departments. Each department is responsible for the oversight of its respective aspect of Gnomish society: State, Defense, Intel and Engineering.

  

== History ==

As the Third War raged on, the [[Dwarves]] of [[Ironforge]] regrettably awoke the [[Troggs]] whilst digging near [[Uldaman]]. Attracted to the impressive technology of the Gnomes, the Troggs constructed tunnels and successfully breached the lowest levels of Gnomeregan. With no formal Gnomish King, High Tinker Mekkatorque acted as leader of the Gnomes during the Trogg invasion, aided by his most trust advisor [[Sicco Thermaplugg]].

Determined not to be a distraction, Mekkatorque withheld knowledge of the Trogg invasion even as he withdrew Gnomish troops from the Alliance military. For years the Gnomes fought the Trogg invaders, but were repeatedly outnumbered. 

Driven by envy, Sicco Thermaplugg devised a diabolical scheme to frame Mekkatorque and assume the role of High Tinker. With the majority of the Gnomish population safely sealed away in the upper urban tunnels, Thermaplugg sought to eradicate a large portion of them with a false plan of attacking the Troggs with toxic radiation. Having lied to Mekkatorque of the gas' safety to Gnomes and effectiveness against Troggs, Thermaplugg convinced the High Tinker to release the gas throughout Gnomeregan. Its effect was catastrophic, killing as much as 80% of all Gnomish citizens. It had little to no effect against the Troggs, and even served as an enraging catalyst for some. 

After a demoralizing defeat, the Gnomes evacuated their capital city and were granted asylum within Ironforge where they established Tinker Town. As they amassed in their new home, the newly exiled Gnomes were outraged over the systemic failures leading to the invasion   

High Tinker Mekkatorque, distraught with guilt and shame for his failures in Gnomeregan, was determined to do right by his people. The ruling council of Gnomes and the High Tinker commissioned the [[Gnomish Federation]] as the centralized authority of all Gnomes. Through it, the Gnomes seek to retake the capital city, embolden their commitment to the Alliance, and to establish themselves as a ruling faction within Azeroth.  

== Structure ==
There are three levels of authority within the Federation; the High Tinker, the Governor, and the Administrative level. Together, they form the [[Executive Council]], responsible for the oversight of critical Federation business.

=== Governor ===
Appointed by the High Tinker, the Governor is the central administrator of the Federation. Responsible for the cohesive efforts of each department, they are the figurehead of Gnomish diplomatic efforts and domestic institutions alike. While new Administrators are chosen through a collaboration of the governor and the rest of the executive level, the governor has final say in new appointments.

The current governor of the Gnomish Federation is [[Oddzag Wirefizz]]. Due to his history of involvement in Gnomish reconnaissance, Wirefizz became a confidential advisor to Mekkatorque during the invasion. Having obtained confidential information of a potential Gnomish counter-offensive in the form of weaponized toxic gas, unaware that it was a malicious coup attempt by Thermalplugg, Wirefizz admonished such a plan and strongly advised Mekkatorque against it. This information was brought to light when the ruling council conducted an investigation into the failed invasion response. Additionally, given his unwavering efforts during the invasion, he was a prime candidate and the eventual nomination to the governorship of the Federation. 

=== Executive Council ===
Consisting of the High Tinker, the Governor and the administrative level, the Executive Council is an elite-level group within the Federation that presides over all top-level Gnomish affairs. While the Governor is the council chairman, the High Tinker retains overriding authority on all matters. Additionally, though the four departments can't override the chairman, if done unanimously, they can appeal to the High Tinker regarding a chairman's decision for a reassessment.  

Membership of the Executive Council is not contingent on being at the Administrative level. Additions to the council are decided unanimously, and a no-vote cannot be overridden, even by the High Tinker. Appointments can only be made by senior leadership, and council members are not granted any additional power. Council membership is highly coveted, and all appointees are typically prestigious, highly-regarded Gnomes, legends within Gnomeregan.

=== Department Administrator ===
Of the four Departments that make up the Federation, each has an appointed Administrator that oversees the functions for which they're responsible. Each Administrator is appointed by the [[Executive Council]], and the process for doing so is highly confidential. Department Administrators are elite Gnomes, masters of their craft and highly regarded in Gnomish society. When the Federation was founded after the fall of [[Gnomeregan]], it was apparent from the outset who the lead contenders were for each department. 

As members of the Executive Council, they're senior leadership, privy to all high-level Federation business. In any given situation, in the absence of the High Tinker or the Federation Governor, an administrator is the highest ranking commander, regardless of the department or rank of any other Federation member. If more than one administrator is on-site, it is considered a joint operation and they're all equal in authority.

While any Administrator has commanding authority over any member of any department, there are operations within each that require department-specific code-word clearance that an Administrator may not possess. This level of confidentiality is maintained by each department Administrator.

=== Executive ===
At the administrative level, Executives serve as officers tasked with the oversight of specific and/or niche divisions within the Federation. Executives are appointed by either the Governor or an Administrator and their authority extends beyond any specific department. Those elevated to the role of Executive are esteemed, devoted Gnomes, loyal servants of the Federation who are trusted with advanced tasks and roles. Though members of the Executive Council, they are not afforded an official vote in council business, nor do they have any overriding authority of influence. However they are granted the chance to weigh in on certain matters, on the condition that their specialty is relevant to the situation.

=== Founder ===
A largely sentimental role, Founders are the original signers of the Federation's charter. Though many have moved on, several remain and are seen as important role models, exemplary Gnomes and non-Gnomes who uphold not just the core values of the Federation, but the Alliance at large. Founders possess no official authority, but their opinions are well regarded and often taken into consideration by those at the Administrative level.

=== Departments ===
When the Federation was founded, it was decided that core aspects of Gnomish society should be divided into specific departments to ensure that in times of crisis, the responsibility of critical functions would never be in doubt.

==== Defense ====
For centuries, the Gnomes lived in unquestionable safety for many reasons; the subterranean nature of Gnomeregan, the proximity to the Dwarves of Ironforge, and the surrounding mountains of Dun Morogh. Security threats were typically small in nature and easily dispatched by the military forces of Ironforge.

A largely uncoordinated militia was about the extent of Gnomeregan's defense force before the invasion. With the establishment of the Federation, the Defense department is tasked with both domestic security and Gnomish military efforts within the Alliance.
====Intel====
Perhaps the most coveted, advanced branch of the Federation, the Gnomish Intelligence corps is known throughout all Azeroth for its covert reconnaissance and intelligence gathering operations. The department has advanced relations with Alliance leadership as one of its primary objectives is to aid in the fight against the Horde.
====Engineering====
The Department of Engineering is officially responsible for all interior matters including, but not limited to: transport, agriculture, utilities, and many more. It is the largest, most segmented department with very little oversight by the Executive level. Most leadership within the Dept of Engineering is elected by Gnomish citizens, and the governor has limited authority over much of the department, except in times in war or declared states of emergency.
====State====
Tasked with oversight of all foreign affairs and diplomatic efforts, the Department of State is the most public, forward-facing department within the Federation.

Though still reeling over the tragedies of Gnomeregan, one of the first orders of the High Tinker after establishing the Federation was to reinforce the Alliance in the fight against the Horde.

Goblins are notoriously neutral, usually found selling arms and supplies to anybody who can pay, and caring little for faction lines. However, the Durotar Labor Union was formed and became members of the Horde after their desertion from the Venture Company following a failed operation in the Stonetalon Mountains. Though they original began their adventure in [[Venture Camp]] in [[Stonetalon Mountains]], the goblins now begin on their island of [[Blackstone Island|Blackstone]]. After their introduction to the Horde, the Union settled down in [[Durotar]], where they built a new capital, [[Sparkwater Port]]. The rocket car is what Union goblins ride as a mount. The goblins speak orcish. ==Background== ===Creation screen description=== ''Shrewd, greedy, and ruthless, goblins have a long-standing reputation for being neutral in the rest of the world, despite the Steamwheedle Cartel allying with the Old Horde during the Second War. Heroes of goblin society are not bastions of honor or integrity. Instead, goblins tend to admire the ruthless acquisition of profit, by any means necessary. Goblins are gifted engineers and accomplished seafarers, but are best known for their unabashed avarice.'' ===Opening cutscene=== ''Generations ago, the goblins ventured out in the world to make deals and find gold. It is from those very upstarts that many goblin industries now reside today. The Venture Company, one such upstart, came to dominate many a goblin life outside of Kezan, the goblin home. The promise of wealth, and the promise of fortune, has stripped many into servitude. After years of greed and wasted opportunity, former goblins of the Venture Company have founded something new: the Durotar Labor Union now stands as a testament to what could be, a callback to the upstart goblins of the past.'' ''Though, one thing always remains in goblin culture: greed, which now seeps deep into the labor union's core. It's up to you to find a way to make it in this hostile world and seek to become your own upstart through hard work and determination, and stand out amongst the rest.'' ===Original opening cutscene=== ''For as long as anyone can remember, the goblins of Undermine have sought out one thing: gold. The Venture Company is among the most successful of their ever-shifting enterprises. It is well known for exploiting resources, both natural and humanoid, by whatever means are available. The Venture Company's brutal tactics and lack of concern for the natural world frequently bring them into conflict with the other nations of Azeroth, especially the druidic races of the night elves and tauren, but there is no better place for an enterprising goblin looking to strike it rich.'' ''As one of the Venture Company's newest recruits, you are ready to lie, cheat and steal your way to the top. But your first expedition may not go quite as planned. {{Neutral}} {{RaceIcon|LeperGnome|Male}} [[Sicco Thermaplugg]] | fleader = | mount = {{RaceIcon|Mechanostrider}} Mechanostrider | homeworld = [[Azeroth]] | environment = | area = [[Azeroth]] | language = Gnomish, Common | exact = | height = | weight = | organization = | alignment = | source = }} The '''gnomes''' (collectively known as '''gnomekind''')[[Patch 1.17.0#New zones and quests]] are a race of diminutive and highly intelligent [[Humanoid|humanoids]], known for their mastery of [[technology]]. For years the gnomes were based in [[Gnomeregan]], providing technological support to the [[Alliance]] during the [[Second War]], until a [[trogg]] invasion and [[Sicco Thermaplugg|treachery]] from within irradiated Gnomeregan and killed as much as eighty percent of the gnomish population. The gnomes were forced into exile in [[Tinker Town]] in the dwarven capital of [[Ironforge]]. ==History== ===Early history=== Little is known concerning gnomish history previous to the [[Second War]] — even among gnomes themselves. Much of gnomish philosophy is focused on forward-thinking, inventive concepts, and little thought has ever been given to history or non-scientific records. The gnomes have not had a proper king or queen for over four hundred years. Instead, they prefer to elect their highest officials for set terms of service; although [[Gelbin Mekkatorque]] has the title "King of Gnomes", he was elected and his position is officially called High Tinker.''World of Warcraft: Game Manual'' Thriving within the wondrous techno-city of [[Gnomeregan]], the gnomes shared the resources of the forested [[Dun Morogh]] peaks with their dwarven cousins for generations. Though dwarves also have a propensity for [[technology]] and engineering, it is gnomes who provide the critical, visionary designs for most of dwarven weapons and steam vehicles.[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_World_of_Warcraft_Townhall/Races_of_Azeroth#Gnomes The World of Warcraft Townhall/Races of Azeroth#Gnomes] ===Second and Third Wars=== During the Second War, the gnomes of Khaz Modan displayed their talents by inventing and piloting the unbelievable Flying Machine. Although having no armaments, these awkward contraptions could be used to survey vast areas of terrain, and detecting the otherwise hidden movements of underwater units, making them invaluable for discovering the movements of the Horde.''Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness'' game manual, ''[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Warcraft_II:_Tides_of_Darkness_manual#Alliance_Air_Units Alliance Air Units]'', Gnomish Flying Machine Gnomish inventors were responsible for creating outlandishly clever contraptions for military use, as well as being responsible perfecting the technique of extracting various chemical compounds out of oil to make gunpowder and explosives. Although the Gnomes are a bit odd and eccentric, none could deny their value to the Alliance.''Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness'' game manual, ''[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Warcraft_II:_Tides_of_Darkness_manual#Alliance_Buildings Alliance Buildings]'', Gnomish Inventor Strangely, the gnomes refused to send any personnel to aid their allies during the [[Burning Legion]]'s invasion during the [[Third War]]. Though their designs also helped turning the tide against the Legion, both the [[Human|humans]] and the Ironforge - and Wildhammer - dwarves were shocked by Gnomeregan's decision to withhold their courageous troops and pilots. When the Third War ended, the Alliance discovered the reason for the gnomes' sudden withdrawal. Apparently, a barbaric menace — [[Trogg|troggs]] — had risen from the bowels of the earth and invaded Gnomeregan. Knowing that their allies' priority was defeating the Burning Legion, the gnomes decided to make their stand alone against the troggs. Though they fought valiantly to save their beloved city, Gnomeregan was lost. At the command of the High Tinker Mekkatorque, the gnomes opened the pressure valves of their giant, grinding machines and released toxic radiation throughout the city. Though the radiation killed the troggs, the gnomes soon discovered that it killed their own people just as quickly. Nearly eighty percent of the gnomish race died within days. Those that survived evacuated the great city and fled to the protection of their dwarven cousins in Ironforge. There, they made a new home in [[Tinker Town]]. ===Mysteries of Azeroth=== Following the fall of Gnomeregan at the hands of the troggs and leper gnomes, the gnomes reclaimed an old factory and refurbished it into new quarters for the gnomish people to use as a staging ground to cleanse and reclaim their city.[[Gelbin Mekkatorque#Quotes]] ==References== {{reflist}} [[Category:Gnomes]] [[Category:Alliance races]]

Their love of money, explosives, and technology makes them a very dangerous race, both to their enemies and themselves. Most goblins have a neutral standpoint, preferring to sell their contraptions, knowledge and services to other races for the right price. However, some goblins that formerly belonged to Venture & Co. They recently broke away and joined the Horde, forming the Durotar Labor Union. Led by Grand Taskmaster Nert Blastentom, they seek to prove to their new Horde allies that they are more than greedy little green creatures. === History === Little is known about the origin of the Goblins and their past, beyond their origin from the Island of Kezan. === Great Wars === {| class="fandom-table" | |This section is '''a [[lore]] stub'''. |} By the time of the [[First War]], the goblins of the [[Steamwheedle Cartel]] had taken over a [[Stranglethorn Vale]] settlement named [[Blackwater Cove]] that had been abandoned by [[Stormwind]] after it was overrun by [[Troll|trolls]]. Upon claiming the town as their own, the goblins renamed it [[Booty Bay]]. During the war, the goblins witnessed the [[Old Horde]]'s arrival and the conquest of [[Stormwind]]. With [[Second War|more conflicts]] in the horizon, they were determined to profit from it. [[Trade Prince Steamwheedle]] allied his [[Steamwheedle Cartel]] with [[Orgrim Doomhammer]]'s Horde and offered aid in form of new technologies, maps, and other useful information to the orcs for the right price. Orgrim treated his new allies as equals, and paid them gold from Stormwind's coffers. The Warchief also hired them to oversee the construction of the [[Horde navy|Horde's fleet]]. However, following the war and the Horde's defeat, the Steamwheedle Cartel and other goblins realized that it was much better to remain neutral due to thriving trades. Still, this made diplomacy difficult, as most of the nations of the [[Alliance of Lordaeron|Alliance]] were now wary of their loyalty, with [[Krix Wiklish|ambassador Wiklish]] not being seriously considered at the [[Lordaeron's palace|court]] of [[Lordaeron (kingdom)|Lordaeron]]. Approximately four years after the Second War, the goblin city of [[Gadgetzan]] had already been built in [[Tanaris]] on [[Kalimdor]], as it was visited by [[Greydon Thorne]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Grim Batol]], Deathwing also still had goblin servitors, just as he did during the War of the Ancients. The three known ones were [[Kryll]], [[Nullyn]], and [[Voyd]]. === World of Warcraft === '''This section concerns content related to the original ''[[World of Warcraft]]''.''' {| class="fandom-table" | |This section is '''a [[lore]] stub'''. |} The goblins of the [[Steamwheedle Cartel]] offered their services to the Alliance and Horde across the world. The [[Venture Company]], however, began hostile campaigns in various territories, prompting various conflicts with the two factions. Several goblins joined the [[Dark Horde]] stationed at [[Blackrock Mountain]] and its surroundings. === Mysteries of Azeroth === Several Goblins belonging to Venture Co. separated after several years of abuse and mistreatment by the company, willing to seek a better future in which to continue feeding their greed, together they formed the Durotar Labor Union. Guided by Nert Blastentom, they swore allegiance to the Horde and as such, became part of it, settling mostly on the coasts of Durotar and Blackstone Island, they seek to prove that they are capable members of the New Horde.

=Description=
Gnolls are brutish demi-humans that resemble a cross between a man and a [[hyena]].  They stand anywhere from 6 1/2 to 8 feet tall and are covered in fur that ranges from grey, greyish blue, greyish green, red-orange, brown and black.  Their upper extremities end in large clumsy hands that are capable of grasping tools and weapons, and their lower extremities end in paws that allows them to sprint rapidly.

From the "Warcraft RPG Manual of Monsters" ''The humanoid stands as tall as a night elf and has a furry, greenish-brownpelt.  It's head is like a hyena's with yellow fangs and bloodshot eyes''

=Locations=
Gnolls main stomping grounds are the [[Eastern Kingdoms]].  Recently, they have also been seen in [[Kalimdor]], though usually under the employ of one of the [[Goblin]] cartels or Pirate Groups.  A Gnoll Seer named [[Sayge]] travels with the [[Darkmoon Faire]] as well.  He gives out fortunes and diffrent buffs based on how you answer his questions.

Gnolls were first seen in Warcraft III.  Thrall leaves his home after a dream tells him to meet with a stranger.  He kills a camp of Gnolls, and levels up.  The Gnolls in question were most likely Mosshide Gnolls, due to their location and coloration.

=Organization=
Gnolls are extremely violent creatures.  They have been known to pick lethal fights with each other over such inane arguments as who has the longer shadow.  Many wonder how these pugnacious creatures ever stand each other long enough to breed.  They only gather in large groups when the oppurtunity for battle or plunder arises.  They make vicious, if unreliable mercenaries, as they will go anywhere they can be offered a good fight.  It is believed by some, that if the Gnolls were ever to put aside their differences long enough to band together into a single group, they would make a formidible army.  

While most Gnolls use melee or ranged weapons, some can use shamanistic or even warlock magic.  Their favored weapons are Maces, or other Blunt items, and crossbows.  When dealing with Magic, Gnolls prefer Nature and Lighting.  Smaller Gnolls and Runts are used as Assassins and Scouts because of their Agility.

Many Gnolls can be seen wearing a round crest with a paw print in the middle.  This symbol is seen in many tribes and its exact meaning is unknown to other races.

Gnolls speak Common and Low Common.

==World of Warcraft==
Starting from north, you'll be at the [[Mor'shan Rampart]] and the [[Mor'shan Base Camp]]. Further south will be a road heading east towards [[Durotar]]. Then carry on going south along the road and arrive at [[Crossroads]] where you cross the East-West road ([[Ratchet]] to [[Honor's Stand]]). Carry on south and you'll pass two oasis' and [[Wailing Caverns]]. A little while later you'll come across a dried-up river which creates a "border" between North and South Barrens. Here also will be [[Beaten Corpse|Mankrik's Wife]], which is a quest target.

After going further down the road, you will find a turn-off which leads into [[Mulgore]] and before that [[Camp Taurajo]]. Further south will be a path to [[Dustwallow Marsh]]. Keep going south and there'll be a dwarven hold named [[Bael Modan]]. After that is a pass and then the [[Great Lift]] and two other instances, [[Razorfen Downs]] and [[Razorfen Kraul]].
